stem.en: Decide whether each statement is true or false.

text.en: At light noise, only one picture is likely to fit what you see.
At heavy noise, many different pictures could be underneath.
A trained model can recover the exact picture from pure noise.
A picture stays hidden in the numbers at the top of the slider.

explanation.en: Light noise leaves the shapes in place. At the top of the slider no number depends on the picture any more, so nothing is hidden there to recover.
